tools.name: recall_rp_memory
tools.description: Retrieve a specific missing fact from stored RP history when it would help the next scene: an event, world fact, relationship, belief, preference, or promise. Use recent conversation and supplied memories directly when they already provide it. This is optional archival lookup, not a routine continuity check, scene planner, or predictor of what someone will do next. Ask one natural-language question about the missing record. For more detail in a supplied memory, use expand_rp_memory. Results are evidence with scene context and dialogue; they do not certify a question’s premise or grant character knowledge.

query.description: A natural-language question about stored roleplay history.

tools.name: expand_rp_memory
tools.description: Expand one clearly chosen memory ref with its details, dialogue, and source evidence. Use this after a supplied record is known to be the right one; do not expand several refs as a general continuity check. Optional focus narrows the result to locally matching evidence inside that memory and may return no match; it never searches other memories. If several records might answer, use recall_rp_memory instead. Use a currently supplied ref.

ref.description: The exact ref supplied beside a memory.

focus.description: Optional detail to look for within this memory.
